mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_log (session_id, user_id, question, answer, retrieved_doc_ids, retrieved_chunk_ids, citations_json, model_name, top_k, confidence_score, hit_flag, latency_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{retrievedDocIds}, #{retrievedChunkIds}, #{citationsJson}, #{modelName}, #{topK}, #{confidenceScore}, #{hitFlag}, #{latencyMs}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT l.*, s.knowledge_domain FROM ai_chat_log l LEFT JOIN ai_chat_session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
SELECT l.*, s.knowledge_domain FROM ai_chat_log l LEFT JOIN ai_chat_session s ON s.id = l.session_id WHERE l.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY l.created_at ASC, l.id ASC
